scope: Browser security regression for local synthetic accounts and trusted same-origin stage frames

results.name: normal cookie and two independent stage sessions coexist
private image loads by authorized blob and is denied to provider and anonymous
bad bearer never falls back to the valid normal cookie
tokens are absent from browser storage, URLs and legitimate parent notifications
scene caption ignores login, reads, failures, wrong sources and unknown events
only the two stage HTML pages permit same-origin embedding; API remains denied
logging out one phone revokes only that token and leaves the other phone and cookie working
no external requests or uncaught browser errors

limits: Does not claim isolation from malicious same-origin JavaScript or extensions.
Natural 30-minute expiry is verified by backend tests; this browser run tests explicit token revocation.
Synthetic account data only; no accuracy or real-user effectiveness claim.
